description: React component for uploading and removing audit logging certificates in the admin console, with tooltip support and cloud installation status handling.

classes.name: AuditLoggingCertificateUploadSetting
classes.description: React functional component for managing audit logging certificate upload and removal with tooltip and status handling.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles change in certificate value, calling onChange prop.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Calls external removeAuditCertificate action with success and error callbacks.

methods.name: uploadAction
methods.description: Calls external uploadAuditCertificate action with success and error callbacks.

methods.name: withTooltip
methods.description: Higher-order component to wrap components with tooltip unless disabled or in stable status.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes the current certificate file, updates state, and refetches status.

methods.name: uploadFile
methods.description: Uploads a new certificate file, updates state, and refetches status.
